name: pomidorqa-tests
description: QA Automation portfolio project: Playwright + TypeScript, Unit/API/E2E, cross-browser CI, Allure and non-functional quality checks

scripts.runtime:check: node -e "const major=Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]); if (major !== 24) { console.error('Node 24 is required; current runtime: ' + process.version); process.exit(1); } console.log('Node runtime OK: ' + process.version);"
scripts.verify:local: npm run runtime:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage:check && npm run test:unit -- --reporter=line && npm run test:api -- --reporter=line
scripts.lint: eslint src tests scripts playwright.config.ts playwright.visual.config.ts
scripts.gate: npm run runtime:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage:check && npm run test:unit -- --reporter=line && npm run test:api -- --reporter=line && npm run test:e2e
